hunks.baseline: At the moment the second hand of the clock granted to only one person on this vast battlefield began to move—
hunks.sol: The second hand of a clock granted to only one person on this vast battlefield began to move.

hunks.baseline: And at its center, four figures were hurtling toward one another with all their might.
hunks.sol: And at its center, four figures hurtled toward one another with all their might.

hunks.baseline: And one of them was Jin Taekyung.
hunks.sol: Among them was Jin Taekyung.

hunks.baseline: A strike that split mountains, faster than sound itself.
hunks.sol: A strike that seemed capable of splitting a mountain, faster than sound itself.

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung wondered whether he could have properly seen that movement even in his usual condition.
hunks.sol: Could Jin Taekyung have followed that movement even in his usual condition?

hunks.baseline: Even if he had, he wouldn’t have dared to meet the enormous Force coiling around the blade head-on.
hunks.sol: Even if he had, he wouldn’t have dared meet the enormous Force coiling around the blade head-on.

hunks.baseline: In Jin Taekyung’s hazy pupils, like a sky clouded over, the blood-red blade and its blazing Force passed within a hair’s breadth of his face.
hunks.sol: In Jin Taekyung’s eyes, hazy as a clouded sky, the blood-red blade and its blazing Force passed barely an inch from his face.

hunks.baseline: Along the path that missed him by mere inches, the ground split as easily as tofu.
hunks.sol: Following the strike’s path, the ground split like tofu mere inches from him.

hunks.baseline: The wind pressure whipped around like a blade and tore at his body, but Jin Taekyung had already forgotten pain. As if entranced, he thrust out his spear.
hunks.sol: The wind pressure whipped around like a blade and raked his body, but Jin Taekyung had already forgotten pain. As if entranced, he thrust out his spear.

hunks.baseline: Two streams of flame surged forward as one, while violet Force, like the colors of sunset, scattered like flower petals.
hunks.sol: Two streams of flame surged forward as one, while sunset-violet Force scattered like flower petals.

hunks.baseline: Though their renown varied, each of the three Supreme Peak masters could make the entire Murim tremble on the strength of his name alone. Together, they launched a perfect combined attack.
hunks.sol: Their renown might differ, but each of the three Supreme Peak masters could make the entire Murim tremble at the sound of his name. Together, they launched a perfect combined attack.

hunks.baseline: An enormous energy boiled up in an instant.
hunks.sol: Enormous qi boiled up in an instant.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, the Blood Lord’s hands—now both free of the hilt—struck through space like twin bolts of lightning.
hunks.sol: At the same time, the Blood Lord’s hands, now free of the hilt, struck through space like a bolt of lightning.

hunks.baseline: Twin palms, faster than sound itself.
hunks.sol: Two palms, faster than sound itself.

hunks.baseline: RUMBLE, RUMBLE……!
hunks.sol: RUMBLE, RUMBLE…!

hunks.baseline: A deep reverberation surged through the devastated battlefield.
hunks.sol: A deep reverberation spread through the devastated space.

hunks.baseline: It swept over the countless fanatics’ corpses, now scattered as chunks of flesh, and reached the three men staggering back to their feet.
hunks.sol: It swept past the fanatics’ corpses, scattered in countless chunks of flesh, and reached the three men staggering as they steadied themselves.

hunks.baseline: He had put tremendous power into that strike.
He had poured a third of his strength into a single attack.
hunks.sol: He had put tremendous power into that strike—poured a third of his strength into a single attack.

hunks.baseline: It had been powerful enough to erase every living thing within a radius of over ten jang and turn the area into a hellscape where only death remained.
hunks.sol: Enough to erase every living thing within a radius of over ten jang and turn the area into a hellscape where only death remained.

hunks.baseline: Of course, he hadn’t thought the outcome was entirely impossible.
hunks.sol: Of course, the outcome wasn’t entirely beyond what he’d expected.

hunks.baseline: It was just as the Blood Lord took a step forward, a low laugh escaping him.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord let out a low laugh and took a step forward.

hunks.baseline: A strange sensation came over him without warning.
hunks.sol: Something felt wrong.

hunks.baseline: He raised his hand to inspect it, and his gaze immediately turned cold.
hunks.sol: He raised his hand to see what it was, and his gaze turned cold.

hunks.baseline: A bead of blood welled up through a shallow split in his skin—too slight to even call a wound—and ran across his palm.
hunks.sol: Beads welled up from a shallow split in his skin—too slight to even call a wound—and ran across his palm.

hunks.baseline: From the very hand that had just met someone’s attack head-on.
hunks.sol: The very hand that had just met someone’s attack head-on.

hunks.baseline: “This is……”
hunks.sol: “This is…”

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord’s voice trailed off. Slowly, he lifted his head.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord trailed off and slowly lifted his head.

hunks.baseline: One man, covered in blood from head to toe, breathing hard as he steadied himself.
hunks.sol: One man, covered in blood from head to toe, struggling to catch his breath.

hunks.baseline: None of their strikes could have broken the Palm Force gathered in his hands.
hunks.sol: None of their strikes should have been able to break the Palm Force gathered in his hands.

hunks.baseline: Though it had been only a single exchange, the Blood Lord had realized once again just how immense the power within him was at this moment.
hunks.sol: It had been only a single exchange, but the Blood Lord had realized once again just how immense the power within him was.

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord greedily swallowed the blood. Intoxicated by his strength surging anew, the monster shot through space like a flash of light.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord greedily swallowed the blood. Intoxicated by the strength surging through him anew, the monster shot through space like a flash of light.

hunks.baseline: And Jin Taekyung knew that better than anyone. Which was why he couldn’t understand what was happening.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung knew that better than anyone. Which was why he couldn’t understand what was happening.

hunks.baseline: Why was the Blood Lord’s movement, faster than wind, sound, even light—
hunks.sol: Why was the Blood Lord’s movement, seemingly faster than wind, sound, even light—

hunks.baseline: Missing him by a hair every time, every single moment?
hunks.sol: Missing him by a hair every time?

hunks.baseline: Amid flashes that constantly blurred his vision, he simply kept moving as if entranced.
hunks.sol: Amid the flashes that continually washed across his hazy vision, he simply kept moving as if entranced.

hunks.baseline: He brought his advancing foot back to where it had been, ducked his head, and let the blood-red Force pass overhead.
hunks.sol: He brought his advancing foot back to where it had been and ducked his head. The blood-red Force passed overhead.

hunks.baseline: A flawless dodge, without a moment’s hesitation.
hunks.sol: A nearly flawless dodge, without a moment’s hesitation.

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung himself didn’t know how he could evade such a swift and ferocious strike. He didn’t know why he’d made that choice, either.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung himself didn’t know how he had evaded such a swift, ferocious strike. He didn’t know why he’d moved that way, either.

hunks.baseline: Just as the Red Blade, descending toward the crown of Jin Taekyung’s head, abruptly changed direction—
hunks.sol: The Red Blade was descending toward the crown of his head when it abruptly changed direction.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: With a single deafening crash, Cheongpung, who had rushed in to attack from the blind spot, dropped to one knee and spat up blood.
hunks.sol: Cheongpung, rushing in from the Blood Lord’s blind spot, dropped to one knee and spat up blood.

hunks.baseline: Above him, the Red Blade had wiped away the path of the Thirty-Six Plum Blossom Swords in an instant and crashed down like lightning, its weight pressing into his sword as if it weighed ten thousand geun.
hunks.sol: Above him, the Red Blade had wiped away the path of the Thirty-Six Plum Blossom Swords in an instant. It crashed down like lightning and bore upon his sword with the weight of ten thousand geun.

hunks.baseline: With martial prowess this immense, and Jin Taekyung clearly dying, why couldn’t he finish this simple, certain fight?
hunks.sol: With martial prowess this immense, and Jin Taekyung clearly dying, why couldn’t he finish this simple fight whose outcome was so certain?

hunks.baseline: As the Blood Lord spat out the words, the blood-red Force swelled and surged into the blade.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord spat out the words. The blood-red Force swelled and dug into Cheongpung’s blade.

hunks.baseline: Feeling a wave of heat sweep in from behind him, the Blood Lord released the hilt without hesitation and thrust out a fist.
hunks.sol: Heat swept in from behind him. The Blood Lord released the hilt without hesitation and thrust out a fist.

hunks.baseline: White flames and blood-red Force charged at each other, each trying to devour the other.
hunks.sol: White light-flames and blood-red Force charged at each other, each trying to devour the other.

hunks.baseline: Blood-red Force swallowed the flames. With an explosion, Jeok Cheongang’s body was sent flying helplessly and rolled across the ground.
hunks.sol: Blood-red Force swallowed the flames. With an explosion, Jeok Cheongang was sent flying helplessly and rolled across the ground.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, an alarm rang in the Blood Lord’s mind, and a gust of wind cut through space.
hunks.sol: An alarm rang in the Blood Lord’s mind, and a current of air crossed the space between them.

hunks.baseline: In time slowed to a crawl, the Blood Lord turned. Jin Taekyung’s figure was fixed in his blood-red pupils, thrusting out his spear with unfocused eyes.
hunks.sol: In time slowed to a crawl, the Blood Lord turned. Jin Taekyung filled his blood-red eyes, thrusting out his spear with a hazy gaze.

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord couldn’t even manage to say the words *How?*
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord couldn’t even get out the word *How?*

hunks.baseline: He couldn’t think about how he, overwhelmingly powerful as he was, had failed to sense the dying wretch before him as he crept closer to death by the second.
hunks.sol: Nor could he think how he, overwhelmingly powerful as he was, had lost track of the presence of a bloodied wretch sinking deeper into death with every passing moment.

hunks.baseline: And Jin Taekyung was no different.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung was no different.

hunks.baseline: It was as if someone else, someone he couldn’t see, were whispering in his ear.
hunks.sol: It was as if someone he didn’t know were whispering in his ear.

hunks.baseline: Time was running out. A horrible weariness—and an even stronger feeling of death—was seeping into his body.
hunks.sol: As the time dwindled, terrible weariness—and the chill of death, stronger still—seeped into his body.

hunks.baseline: The shouts and screams of friend and foe, ringing out without pause even now. The cold clang of steel. The sound of a trumpet, now drawing close.
hunks.sol: The shouts and screams of friend and foe, ringing out without pause. The cold clang of steel. The sound of a trumpet, now drawing close.

hunks.baseline: Leaving it all behind, as if it had been decided from the beginning, Jin Taekyung let the flames deep inside his body flow toward a single point.
hunks.sol: Leaving it all behind, as if this had been decided from the beginning, Jin Taekyung sent the flames deep inside his body toward a single point.

hunks.baseline: *Thud.*
hunks.sol: *Pshk.*

hunks.baseline: A spearhead carrying faint warmth pierced the palm wrapped in Force and drove through.
hunks.sol: The spearhead, carrying a faint heat, pierced the palm wrapped in Force and drove on through.

hunks.baseline: Past that very hand, whose wound, for some reason, had yet to heal.
hunks.sol: Past that very hand, whose wound, for some reason, still hadn’t healed.

hunks.baseline: The monster’s eyes flew wide, bulging as they filled with shock.
hunks.sol: The monster’s eyes bulged wide with shock.
